question: What syllable count results when the haṃsa seed is joined at the end of all parts?
premises: The haṃsa seed is joined at the end of all parts.
The resulting form is stated to become twenty-syllabled.
inference: Therefore joining the haṃsa seed at the end of all parts yields a twenty-syllabled form.
plain_english: When joined with the haṃsa seed at the end of all, it then becomes twenty-syllabled.
